definitions.full: H7583. shaah II. [ שָׁאָה ] verb Hithpa`el gaze (apparently || form of שָׁעָה , q. v.); — Participle masculine singular לָהּ מִשְׁתָּאֵה הָאִישׁ Gen 24:21 (J) the man was gazing at her (Ges § 130a ). [ שָׁאט ], שְׁאָט see II. שׁוּט . שְׁאִיָּה see I. שׁאה . above
